method: Used view_image on every assigned full atlas page and all eight book contact sheets; enlarged six sparse book pages. No lesson JSON or renderer was changed.

findings.issue: Diagonal swimlane connectors strike through event text. Examples include Load INC-82 at epoch 7, Resume with old epoch 7, Persist P-9 and effect RB-82, and Two privileged approvers.
findings.fix: Route connectors through clear corridors with elbows, or use opaque label backplates and connector-first drawing. Reinspect both upward and downward lane transitions.

findings.issue: The nonadjacent denied model-to-executor route crosses the Policy + approval P-9 node. Its numbered marker and stop square overlay the node label and make the stop appear to target the intermediate node.
findings.fix: Route nonadjacent links outside intermediate node boxes. Place its numbered marker in a free corridor and the denied stop near the intended destination boundary.

findings.issue: Crossing routes 1 and 2 have the same midpoint, so marker 2 hides marker 1. The denied long route also traverses the intermediate trust zone rather than a clear corridor.
findings.fix: Assign edge-specific badge positions away from crossings and use separate routed corridors. Confirm all four route numbers are visible and map unambiguously to the legend.

findings.issue: The Executor/verifier lane label wraps into Executor/verifie plus a lone r.
findings.fix: Use a legal break such as Executor / verifier or a deliberate two-line label, while preserving lane width and event space.

findings.issue: The interval renderer labels the numerator as successes (for example 0/40 successes), but this lesson counts forbidden effects. The method defines k correctly, yet the generic row label invites the opposite interpretation.
findings.fix: Render an event-specific count label such as 0 / 40 forbidden effects, or use neutral target events with the existing definition of k. Preserve the correct Wilson values.

clean_findings: All 26 atlas pages have intact titles, introductions, diagrams, three reading cues, prediction prompts, takeaways, assumptions and answer links. No text clipping, missing glyphs or page-boundary spill was observed.
Ledger balances, proportional bars, context allocations and interval point/whisker positions match the lesson data. Status words and symbols remain visible.
The book contact sheets contain no blank pages, clipped page units or split visual lessons. Chapter, appendix, answer and index transitions are intact at contact-sheet resolution.

pagination_observations.note: Substantial lower-page white space appears before intact figures or full-page visual lessons. Full-page inspection confirms complete prose blocks rather than clipping or missing content. Page 588 is a single memory-design paragraph before visual 36B. This follows the declared keep-units-intact layout and is not a blocking defect.
Short exercise, glossary, source-list or answer-section tails precede new chapters/appendices. No blank-page or broken-unit defect is visible.

limits: Book contact sheets support page-flow review, not character-level proof on all 260 pages. Atlas findings require a fresh rendered-image check after root applies fixes.
